entries.1bc2054f93e170fe: This is the core division that plans, manufactures and sells business wear and related apparel, as well as bags, jewelry and apparel, and its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥52,310 million. The company operates 'Konaka Futata', 'SUIT SELECT', 'DIFFERENCE' and others; Samantha Thavasa Japan Limited handles bags, jewelry and apparel, Bāndesutorōzu Japan Limited handles apparel, and Aisutecchi Co., Ltd. handles reuse and clothing alterations. The breakdown by product is heavy apparel ¥22,463 million, fashion accessories ¥14,421 million, light apparel ¥9,753 million, medium apparel ¥4,920 million and other ¥750 million.
entries.2fe9b911b2f0855d: This is the division in which the subsidiary Konaka Enterprise Co., Ltd. operates after-school English education under 'Kids Duo', 'Kids Duo International' and others, and its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,015 million.
entries.819fa3f6ad4c1e9d: The company is headquartered in Totsuka Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture, and the group consists of the company, 11 subsidiaries and one affiliate. Its three reportable segments are the Fashion Business, the Food Service Business and the Education Business, and consolidated employees as of September 30, 2025 numbered 1,882. The company operates 411 stores, and the group as a whole operates 607 stores.
entries.8dc2bfec94d95740: This is the division in which the subsidiary Konaka Enterprise Co., Ltd. operates tonkatsu specialty restaurants such as 'Katsuya' and 'Karayama' and others, and its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,161 million.
entries.a59695d38a4cfa05: A company whose main business is fashion, centered on men's clothing, and which also operates a food service business and an education business.
